title: Inspect six independently source-authorized coordination factors on a selected Command work item
goal: Implement CAP-CMD-104 Class-0 inspector of priority, severity, urgency, impact, confidence, and SLA risk on the existing selected authorized Incident/Task without conflation, inference or mutation.
invariants: Exactly six separate owner-sourced factors, nil means unknown/not disclosed; never derive effective priority from technical severity.
No new Work Queue route or client-selected tenant/environment/permission; only selected already-reauthorized work item can request factors.
Optional host FactorsOwner must independently authorize each returned external source; unavailable factors are nil and no new rights flow from Incident selection.
Read-only; OPEN-013 Class-2 mutations of priority/impact and product IAM remain excluded.
Existing unselected queue rows, views, status, sort, cursor and selection remain backwards compatible.
security_properties: Host session and every Command object ACL evaluated by existing Project prior to any factor resolution.
Denied/foreign/off-page object never invokes factor adapter or emits factor metadata.
Invalid factor source/value/time or host failure emits generic 503 with no partial authorized item data.
HTML uses html/template escaping and existing CSP/no-store headers.
inputs: Full canonical CAP-CMD-104 §§1–27 and CAP-CMD-101 §§1–27; Command module ownership; Incident/Task objects; tenant/permission contracts; Shared Saved Views catalog
Frozen PR #167 HEAD 8260b1e65e61efe638cce44b5608e828e293f5b8; exact-head three-OS runtime and kernel SUCCESS
No current production factor data connector; bounded host adapter only, no fabricated source.
outputs: Optional six distinct source-provenance coordination dimensions in selected JSON and native HTML, missing sources explicitly unknown.
Independent host source-factor authorization adapter; no mutation, scoring, export, new route or paid API.
Negative authorization and provenance/HTML tests plus exact-head CI.
acceptance_tests: Selected Incident with severity critical but Command priority low retains both distinct values and source/time; no inferred reclassification.
Without factor provider: six unknown in selected HTML; unrelated unselected JSON unchanged.
Forbidden Incident/Task, foreign tenant, off-page or revoked object never calls source adapter.
Malformed factor metadata or source backend denial fails closed without partial response; HTML escapes attacker-controlled labels.
definition_of_ready: E10-CMD-101I-SELECTION IMPLEMENTED on frozen PR #167 and its exact-head CI verified successful.
CAP-CMD-104 read-only inspection Class 0 does not require resolving OPEN-013 mutation policy.
definition_of_done: Actual selected-only six-dimension inspection behavior and source authorization isolation demonstrated on GitHub CI exact SHA.
Only E10-CMD-104A-READONLY task IMPLEMENTED, neither CAP-CMD-104 canonical acceptance nor main merge claimed.
One independent read-only L2 on materially new factor-owner security boundary.

migration.rationale: Only optional host projection on the already-authorized selected read-only route.

rollback.strategy: Remove optional FactorsOwner and factors fields, retain existing selected context.
verification: Existing six-view unselected JSON and ACL tests remain passing

performance_budget.rationale: One existing bounded <=5000 Owner.List/CanRead traversal per queue request, plus at most ONE selected-item factor read from the host; no new sorting, pagination pass or external source calls from the runtime.
metrics: At most one ReadAuthorizedFactors call for one selected currently authorized row, never for unselected, denied or off-page.
Preserve current <=50 visible rows and <=5000 owner candidate bound.
